title: New Scenery & Airports in MSFS2024 Marketplace ✈️🌍 | Weekly Update | Week 50
description:
🔍 Description
🚀A bunch of new airports and scenery upgrades have arrived in the marketplace, including Pangborn Memorial Airport, Hurghada International Airport, Murray Airfield, and several others. Some even come with refreshed surroundings. On the scenery side, the focus is on improved night lighting and updated ground vehicles.

📹 Other marketplace additions
